tasks.description: Wear your team's colors or jersey today. Take a photo of yourself in the outfit, face visible, good lighting. Proof note: name the team you're supporting.

Check in at wherever you're watching the final, whether that's a bar, a friend's living room, or your own couch. Photo must show the screen or setup and something in frame that places you there (drink, snack, room detail). Proof note: describe where you are and who you're watching with.
Write your final score prediction on a piece of paper in big letters and take a photo of it with your hand holding it, face not required. Proof note: state your predicted final score.
Post about the final on any social platform (a story, status, or comment) and take a screenshot showing your post live with your username visible. Proof note: paste the text of what you posted.
